newsitem.title: USA: Cooper Cameron acquisitions add up, continue.
newsitem.headline: Cooper Cameron acquisitions add up, continue.

text.p: Cooper Cameron Corp said Tuesday that two recent wellhead acquisitions "should be immediately additive to earnings and cash flow for the Cameron segment" and the company plans to "actively pursue similar acquisitions" worldwide.
Cooper Cameron said in a release that it recently closed two small acquisitions of Rocky Mountain-area companies engaged primarily in the remanufacturing and service of surface wellheads.
The company said Wellhead Services Inc, based in Farmington, N.M., was acquired effective January 31, 1997, and Marta-Co, based in Vernal, Utah, was acquired in April 1997.

President and Chief Executive Officer Sheldon Erikson said in the release that the acquisitions should be "immediately" accretive to earnings, and the company plans to "exploit opportunities like these in order to effectively utilize (its) free cash flow and improve (its) market position in selected areas."
Erikson added the company will pursue similar acquisitions "not only in the U.S., but in Cooper Cameron's markets worldwide."

The company Tuesday reported net income of $19.4 million, or $0.72 per share, for the quarter ended March 31, 1997, compared with net income of $7.7 million, or $0.29 per share, for the first quarter of 1996.
